title: Accountant II
description: MAIN PURPOSE OF THE JOB The Accountant is responsible for the overall financial support including field support during trainings/workshops by ensuring all financial transactions follow MSH financial policies and procedures and donor regulations. She/he will ensure financial documents submitted for review are complete, applicable taxes are deducted for financial transaction settlement, compiles payment sheet details during training for urgent financial settlement and follows up on timely settlement of taxes. S/he will also support the finance unit during audit process. SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITY Support Country Finance Management Make sure that all financial documents (JVs, PVs, and Deposit vouchers) and any related documents are reviewed and shared with the finance coordinator for proper filing. Ensure all submitted MSH and sub contractor financial documents are complete and accurate and process cover payment documentation for approvals. Payment processing Ensure all financial documents are properly sequenced, have the applicable payment details attached for supervisors review and approvals. Ensure all financial documents have the required supporting documentation and all supporting documents are clear and original. Ensure receipts attached with payment documents are legally acceptable and have attachments as required. Ensure timely settlement of outstanding work and staff advances including sub contractor staff advances. Support with the review of sub contract invoices and consultant invoices. Training support Support during trainings/workshops for registration/attendance sheet recording and support with perdiem settlement preparation. Ensure applicable documentations are collected for urgent settlement. Support with audit process and organizing documents for audit and compliance review. Assist in the preparation of smooth conduct of internal and external audits. Qualifications REQUIRED MINIMUM EDUCATION Bachelor’s degree or Master’s Degree in accounting, Finance, Business management, or related field from a recognized university Required Minimum Experience Previous experience in USG-funded projects of similar nature, and good knowledge of USG rules and regulations. Experience in working and reviewing partners and sub contractors/grant documents is an advantage. Knowledge And Skills Oversee the overall financial activities of the project and ensure that activities comply with MSH Policies and procedures and with USG donor rules and regulations and statutory obligations including contractual requirements. Prepare payment vouches, cash receipts vouchers, and journal vouchers in accordance with MSH policies and procedures. Ensure all transactions have the necessary approvals, are accurately coded and charged to the right expenditure type, with appropriate documentation, and recorded into the QuickBooks database. Laise with central level technical advisors and regional managers for timely preparation and submission of monthly fund requests. Follow the timely settlement of outstanding work and staff advances and prepare an aging analysis report to be submitted to the MSH home office monthly. Prepare check payments, bank transfers, and bank letters in the name of the authorized payees/vendors as necessary. Review petty cash payments and replenishment requests to ensure they are in line with MSH Ethiopia’s petty cash policies. Prepare monthly payroll benefits, process timely payments based on MSH and donor applicable procedures. Responsible for workshop/training or similar event registration and attendance sheet follow up, compilation of payment sheet for urgent settlement by collecting accurate bank data and supporting documentation. Assist in the preparation of provident fund and government payables (withholding tax, income tax, pension) and make sure such payables are paid to the applicable authority office in time. Compile and process monthly VAT claims for a refund from the DoS as applicable. Assist in the preparation and smooth conduct of internal and external audit. MSH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. MSH complies with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act, Section 4212 of the Vietnam Era Readjustment Assistance Act, as amended, and all related applicable regulations. title: Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer - iOS/Android, KMP & DevOps
description: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About Us We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge. We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process. Job Description We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms. Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application. You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers. Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important. Key Responsibilities Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges. Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform. Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required. Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases. Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations. Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes. Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions. Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners. Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments. Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting. Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team. Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable. Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing. Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers. Required Qualifications Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development. Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience. Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms. The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure. Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security. Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting. Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting. Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration. Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners. Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software. The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review. Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge. The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively. Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached. Especially Valuable Experience Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team. GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies. Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior. Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments. Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services. Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together. title: Budget & Cost Division Head
description: Job brief People First Consult is looking for a highly analytical and results-oriented Head of Cost and Budget on behalf of a well-established industrial manufacturing company within a prominent Ethiopian business group. The successful candidate will lead budgeting, cost management, financial planning, and performance analysis to strengthen cost efficiency, financial discipline, and informed business decision-making. Key Responsibilities Lead the preparation, consolidation, and monitoring of annual budgets and periodic forecasts. Oversee cost accounting, product costing, cost allocation, and variance analysis. Monitor production and operational costs and identify cost-saving opportunities. Prepare management reports, financial analyses, and performance dashboards. Collaborate with Finance, Production, Procurement, and other departments to improve cost control and resource utilization. Strengthen budgetary controls, reporting procedures, and cost management systems. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field. A master's degree or professional certification such as ACCA, CPA, or CIMA is an advantage. At least 7 years of relevant experience, including 3 years in a managerial role. Strong experience in budgeting, cost accounting, financial analysis, and management reporting. Manufacturing-sector experience, particularly in product costing and production cost analysis, is highly desirable. Excellent analytical, numerical, communication, and leadership skills.

title: Senior Android Developer - Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding

Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior. Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software. A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents. The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team. Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached. UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility. NFC and other device-to-device interactions. Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents. What We Offer A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective. Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities. Ownership of meaningful mobile development work. The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents. Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience. Remote Working Arrangement Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process. Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.
